# MODUNERA

MODUNERA manufactures premium tiny houses in Türkiye for projects in Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, Luxembourg and Switzerland. Tiny houses are the core offer; modular buildings, steel structures, bungalows and bespoke furniture are additional project-based capabilities.

Country, permit, customs and transport content is general guidance reviewed on 2026-08-13. It does not replace current authority, legal, customs, tax, structural or energy advice. Project approval and deliverability are confirmed only after document, site and route checks.
